cases.title: All P1 component cases pass from the documented invocation (packaged entrypoint, clean venv)
An intentionally broken lineage or missing source proof fails the harness
Baseline unrelated failures remain visible rather than silently removed
Outputs can be replayed/inspected locally without calling the original website
Single-page and mixed-batch journeys via the packaged entrypoint in a clean environment
Fixture assertions: spans, lineage, empty vs error, no graph connection, limits, cancellation
Setup/test commands, package/source digests, output examples and resource measurements recorded
Hidden imports/services audited; predicted vs actual symbols compared
Release checklist invokes only P1 gates and defers browser/graph/learning
